Sewer camera inspection done right

A camera inspection lets us look inside your drain or sewer line without digging. We feed a waterproof camera through the pipe and watch the live picture on a monitor.

It shows exactly where a blockage, break or buildup is, so you know what you are paying for before any work starts.

What we handle

  • Main sewer line inspections
  • Drain lines that keep clogging
  • Locating breaks, buildup and blockages
  • Checking a line before or after a repair
  • Residential and commercial lines

When a camera inspection makes sense

  • The same drain keeps clogging
  • Several drains back up at once
  • Sewage smell in the yard or the house
  • Soggy or sunken spots in the yard
  • Before a major sewer repair

Knowing what is wrong first means you only pay to fix what is actually broken.

Questions about sewer camera inspection

Do you have to dig to inspect the line?

No. The camera goes in through an existing cleanout, drain or vent, so there is no digging just to look.

Can I see what the camera finds?

Yes. We show you what the camera finds and explain it, so you understand the problem before any work is done.

Do you give free estimates?

Yes. Estimates are free within San Antonio city limits.

What are your hours?

We are open Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm. Weekends are for scheduled and emergency work. We are not a 24 hour service.
